quarterly_data.quarter: Merck & Co. press release: Merck Enters into Exclusive Global License Agreement with (09-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Merck entered into an exclusive global license agreement with SciBrunch Therapeutics for SPR2015, a preclinical oral KRAS G12D (ON) inhibitor, gaining worldwide rights to develop, manufacture and commercialize it. SciBrunch receives an upfront payment of $400 million and is eligible for development, commercialization and other milestones across multiple indications, for a total potential aggregate value of $2.13 billion including the upfront; the transaction has closed. Merck will record a pre-tax charge of $400 million, or approximately $0.13 per share, in GAAP and non-GAAP third-quarter 2026 results.
quarterly_data.figure: $400 million upfront; total potential value $2.13 billion
